pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal and rounded dark regions with moderately smooth edge gradients; patch area is largest on the mid-flank and decreases significantly in size toward the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space; junction nodes are primarily trifurcated; pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the lateral flank with slight narrowing observed at the transition to the limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the upper neck displays a dense, low-amplitude jagged silhouette with high-frequency serrations against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-plumaged avian organism perched directly on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper neck and shoulder.
